meta.caveat: Counts of plausible values (from hardware/spec facts) give an upper bound on bits per attribute. They are not frequencies from a real population. For real numbers supply --reference with a `distributions` map built from your own data (see docs/privacy/fingerprinting/harness.md).

sources.hardwareConcurrency: Public Apple Silicon/Intel Mac core counts (M1 8, M1 Pro/Max 8-10, M1 Ultra 20, M2 8-12, M2 Ultra 24, M3 8-16, M4 10-16; Intel 4-16).
sources.deviceMemory: Chromium caps navigator.deviceMemory at 8 and buckets to powers of two.
sources.others: Hand-chosen coarse sets; adjust as you learn more.
